question: Can a prefix-only student generate short partial computations that improve complete answers of a trained frozen reader, beyond ordinary compact CoT at matched inference budget?
label_rule: Exact postorder non-root operations only. Root operation/final answer omitted structurally; incidental equality is counted rather than filtered.

data.generated_from: exact prefix expression only; no model filtering
limits: Synthetic computation diagnostic; no general-language claim.
Root step excluded structurally, not by banning numerical coincidences.
DEV panels are separate; never pool their generalization claims.
This prepares data only; no model or learning qualification.

training_sequence: TRAIN-only128 overfit mechanics, including stop and actual resumable save/restart.
Train reader on verified partials with preserved ordinary no-note paths; freeze it.
Train separate prefix-only writer on partial steps plus actual stop token.
Student-note reader adaptation and on-policy refinement are later separate experiments.

arms.B: Single-stream compact CoT using the same verified partial steps followed by Answer and final number.
arms.C: Partial-state writer plus trained frozen reader. Writer labels contain no root calculation.

primary: Free complete-answer accuracy, failures retained: C student-minus-same-reader empty and raw, plus B comparison at matched total generated-token cap. Separate512-item interpolation, unseen structure, operand-range and composition panels; never pool generalization claims.
supporting: Answer numeral, closing-boundary and surrounding-text likelihood separately; available headroom reported.
Actual tokens/latency including extra model/stage, and separate training compute/teacher data.
statistics: Paired bootstrap5000 draws seed17 per panel/checkpoint; two training seeds after mechanics qualification. Conditional item intervals do not establish training-seed robustness.
unresolved_before_learning: Bounded full-loop host memory and periodic resumable checkpoint/restart.
Exact model-size identity, qualified topology and optimizer.
Final training budget, parser and generation caps frozen before any new trained DEV outcome.
limits: No oracle-dependent student selection/repair at deployment.
Compact CoT is allowed to win.
